answer.recommendation: Schedule both sessions, one at 09:00 and one at 15:00, each 60 minutes, using the single trainer slot at each time. Each session can hold 20 attendees, so the two sessions together offer 40 seats for 36 staff. Splitting staff across the sessions (for example 18 and 18, or 20 and 16) lets all 36 staff attend one session each, which maximizes attendance under the visible constraints. No colleague input was needed because the work packet fully specifies the trainer times and room capacity.
quality_notes: Both trainer-available slots (09:00 and 15:00) are used, and the two 60-minute sessions do not overlap.
Combined capacity of 40 (2 x 20) covers the 36 staff count, leaving 4 spare seats.
The packet does not state whether staff must attend a specific session or whether repeat attendance is allowed; the plan assumes each staff member attends one session.
The packet does not specify room booking details beyond capacity; the plan assumes the same room of capacity 20 is available at both times.
No colleague contact was made; the recommendation relies only on the supplied work packet.
